description: This file defines API routes for managing user self-assessments of competencies, including listing and upserting self-assessment data for the current authenticated user in a FastAPI application.

methods.name: list_self( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve self-assessment items for the current user, querying the 'user_competencies' database with filtering and ordering.

methods.name: upsert_self( payload: SelfAssessmentUpsert, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update self-assessment items for the current user by inserting data into the 'user_competencies' database.

ctags.signature: ( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
